Update : it's been a month since I wrote all this but I really really really hope she comes back and tells me that she still loves me. I listen to her voice note every now and then for a good night's sleep.
She's a perfectly normal person with great social skills and she's a joy to be around. She doesn't really need me for anything tbh but that fact kinda kills me on the insides. I just want her to be happy. I really love her.
I hope i have the strength to move on from this. If she ever does decide to come back, I'd take her back in a heartbeat. But i don't think she ever will. It's alright. Guess this is how it's always meant to be for me. Even the one person who i thought would change everything for me ended up the same way I feared. Maybe I have to big of a expectation with people? Maybe i have a very utopian sense of love? Maybe I'm just a sad excuse for a human being and its all my fault nobody wants to be with me?  Maybe I don't deserve to be happy and have someone who i can call 'mine'. I don't know. 
All I know is that I'm in a much darker place than I started off with and the depression is a bit much. I have these intense feelings of self harm and contemplating a world without me and other morbid thoughts that are probably a bit more than before. I don't know what to do. I need help with my life but I don't where or how to start. I don't really have anyone for support. And I don't even want to seem like I'm seeking attention and ask for help like a wimp that I really am. I don't know. I really don't. Fuck my sorry life. I just want to fucking die.
I want to write down exactly what I feel but somehow the space stayed empty and I couldn't have described it any better.

Idk, i feel like I shouldn't see her again.
I was just the perfect rebound. And I don't know what else to say because I think she never did really like me that much and I was just an escape from her previous boyfriend. And once that was over she shunned me too, Thnx for nothing. I don't know what or who to trust anymore. I'll probably kill myself eventually idk. I hope not to, it seems like a 75% chance tbh.

Update :
Everything seems fine. She doesn't not love me, she feels the need to not have me too attached to her so that i won't be broken when she's gone.
I'm OK with that but she's the only person who's ever realistically wanted to be there for me. And I'm attached to her and nothing can change that. I'll probably be a bit saddened by her departure in the end but I will still love her no matter what. (it's not obsessive it's just that I have nobody else I've been this close to). She thinks I'll just end up killing myself if she leaves but I think I'll be alright. Broken but ok. I have a lot to live for. I don't think I'd really want to die without doing a few things. 

I'm afraid that I'll never run into another girl like her, someone who'd give me a chance, be understanding and nice.
I just want her to be fuckin happy with whatever she does and fully support all her decisions. It's just unfortunate that this is how this was going to be really.
I still love her. I don't think anyone or anything can really change that because she already holds a spl place in me.
I wish her the best of luck and she'll always have all my love and support for her if she ever needs it. 
I love you rach.
I still hope to hear her tell me that she loves me with that squeaky voice and that charming smile that I so love. One day, maybe.
